uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of the album for you. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

autoPhotos.name: Automatic photos
autoPhotos.hint: The album captures great moments on its own. The moments are chosen below.

triggerCrit.name: Critical hits
triggerCrit.hint: A photo of a critical hit (D&D 5e: attack rolls, Crucible: critical successes, other systems: a natural 20).

triggerFumble.name: Fumbles
triggerFumble.hint: A photo of a fumble, the funny memories.

triggerBoss.name: Fallen bosses
triggerBoss.hint: A photo when a boss falls (D&D 5e: creatures with legendary actions or resistances, Crucible: adversaries of the boss rank).

triggerVictory.name: Victories
triggerVictory.hint: A photo when the last enemy of a fight falls.

triggerDeath.name: Farewells
triggerDeath.hint: A photo when a player character dies.

triggerLevelUp.name: Level ups
triggerLevelUp.hint: A photo when a character reaches a new level (D&D 5e and Crucible).

triggerDawn.name: Sunrise
triggerDawn.hint: A photo when the sun rises on a new day (calendars with a sun, such as the ones of D&D 5e and Ember). It shows the heroes on the current scene.

critsBy.name: Whose critical hits
critsBy.hint: Only those of the player characters, or of everyone in the fight.

maxAuto.name: Automatic photos per session
maxAuto.hint: At most this many automatic photos per session, so every photo stays special. 0 means no limit.

cooldown.name: Pause between automatic photos
cooldown.hint: Seconds after an automatic photo before the next one.

perspective.name: Through whose eyes
perspective.hint: Photos show what a player of a character in the picture saw, with their light, vision and fog. If no such player is online, another player's or the GM's view is used. The GM's view never shows hidden tokens.

playerPhotos.name: Photos by players
playerPhotos.hint: Players can send a photo of their view with the camera button.

chatCards.name: Chat messages
chatCards.hint: A chat message with every new photo.

sessionGap.name: New session after
sessionGap.hint: Hours without a photo after which the next photo starts a new session. The GM can also start one in the album.

combatTotals.name: Combat totals on session pages
combatTotals.hint: Each session page also shows the fights of that game night: rounds, damage, healing, defeated foes and the hero of the night, only what players may see. Needs Sephral’s Combat Log & Stats.

SELFTEST.Title: Campaign Album self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the album, the image folder and taking photos. Run it after an update of Foundry or the system.
SELFTEST.Passed: Self test passed: {checks} checks, system support {system}.
SELFTEST.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: The Campaign Album was verified with older versions than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SELFTEST.JournalOwnership: Players cannot see the album. Give everyone at least observer rights.
SELFTEST.JournalOwner: Players own the album journal and could change it. Observer rights are enough.
SELFTEST.Upload: The active GM may not upload files, so photos cannot be stored. Allow uploads for the role in the user permissions.
SELFTEST.Folder: The image folder {folder} could not be created.
SELFTEST.Capture: This client could not take a photo of the scene.
SELFTEST.Generic: {system} has no built in support. Critical hits count as a natural 20, bosses and levels are not recognized.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
